title: Writing Clean JavaScript Code
overview: Clean code is easy to read, understand, and maintain. Good JavaScript practices help developers create reliable and scalable applications.

title: Using let and const Properly
overview: Modern JavaScript applications should prefer const by default and use let only when a value needs to change. Avoid using var in new projects.

title: Avoiding Code Duplication
overview: Repeating the same code multiple times makes applications harder to maintain. Reusable functions and components help avoid duplication.

title: Handling Errors Properly
overview: Applications should handle unexpected situations properly using error handling techniques instead of allowing crashes.

title: Writing Maintainable Code
overview: Maintainable code follows consistent formatting, uses reusable logic, and keeps functions small and focused on one responsibility.

example.title: Maintainable Code Rules
example.content:
✔ Use meaningful names
✔ Keep functions small
✔ Avoid unnecessary complexity
✔ Write reusable logic
